title: Hyakka Ryouran: Samurai Bride Specials
justification: AniList 19255 has 6 episodes (2013-06-26 to 2013-11-27); offline-database synonyms are 'Samurai Bride Specials', 'Samurai Bride Shorts' and 'Momoiro Mankai Original Animation'. AniDB 9398 has two runs on the same six dates: S1-S6 (Sasuke and Musashi at a Public Bath, Kojiro's Maid Training, The Ultimate Swimsuit, Juicy Boobs Project, d'Artagnan Report, The Girls on the Beach) and S7-S12 ('Girls' Talk 1..6', the talk programme, which TVDB lacks and overlay/9398.json unmaps). The entry is the first run: TVDB 186911 0x14-0x19 are 'Samurai Bride Special 01..06' with those very titles on those dates, and TMDB tv/46440 S0E14-19 agree. The detail's 'S1 / S7 match the date' was the two runs sharing dates.
